card.title: How To Fix iPhone XS or Max Black Screen After Apple Logo

source.title: How To Fix iPhone XS or Max Black Screen After Apple Logo

claims.statement: An iPhone XS / XS Max that shows the Apple logo then goes black at SpringBoard handoff, while touch and PC detection work and a restore doesn't help, can have corrupted system configuration in the NAND rather than a display-circuit fault.
Fix: remove and read the NAND (JC BGA110), build a clean configuration for the model keeping the original SN and Wi-Fi/BT MACs (same capacity), write, reball, refit and do a full restore.

procedure: Confirm logo then black with a known-good aftermarket screen.
Confirm it boots to activation via PC.
Remove and read NAND; extract SN, Wi-Fi MAC, BT MAC.
Write a clean config with original data; reball, refit, restore.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Avoid overheating the CPU when refitting NAND.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
